A few notes this unusual month
Spring is here

Careful Boarding for companion animals

Spring traffic is putting fresh pressure on the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways, and this is the moment to stay sharply observant. Staff should expect more last-minute document checks, more crate assessments, and more passenger questions about comfort, feeding, and transfer handling. Every animal must receive patient attention, and every concern must move through the calm stepwise review used by the senior coordinator before any decision is final. Clear notes, steady speech, and careful handoffs remain essential for safety.

Travelers are reminded that small oversights can create avoidable stress for pets and crews alike. Please verify carrier condition, label visibility, and routing details with care, and escalate anything uncertain without delay. The Companion Animal Travel Desk continues to guide passengers with practical support, but good outcomes depend on disciplined routine work at every stage. Keep standards high, keep the atmosphere calm, and treat each booking as a live safety matter.
